added.summary: TSX elements take `touchStick`, `touchPad` and `touchButton` naming an input action (and `deadZone` for a stick): the element's box becomes an on-screen stick, d-pad or button that feeds that action as the documents' `<joystick action>`, `<dpad action>` and `<button data-og-touch>` do, so movement and buttons work with no handler. A disabled or hidden one feeds nothing.
